content.title: About
content.content: Crackers, cheese, reduced fat are crunchy snack crackers made with reduced‑fat cheese powder. They have a light cheese flavor, moderate saltiness and low fat content, making them a convenient snack for those watching their calorie intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The cheese powder is produced from low‑fat cheese, preserving flavor while cutting calories.
Crackers are often used as a base for canapés and party appetizers.
Their low‑fat profile makes them suitable for diets that limit fat.
In some markets they are marketed as “low‑fat cheese crackers” and are popular among athletes.
Their crisp texture is achieved by rapid baking at high temperature.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Reduced fat content makes these crackers less caloric than regular cheese snacks.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Cheese powder provides a modest amount of dairy protein, useful for muscle repair.

items.title: Contains calcium
items.content: Even with reduced fat, the cheese retains some calcium important for bone health.

items.title: Supports weight control
items.content: Low fat and moderate carbohydrate levels allow inclusion in weight‑management plans.

items.title: Convenient snack
items.content: Portable packaging and long shelf life make them handy for travel and work.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The product contains dairy protein and may trigger allergic reactions in people with milk allergy or lactose intolerance.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Salt is added for flavor; individuals monitoring sodium intake should account for it.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Most crackers are made from wheat flour, making them unsuitable for gluten‑free diets.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Crackers can be eaten straight from the pack, paired with low‑fat cottage cheese, yogurt, vegetable dips, or used as a base for mini‑sandwiches.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a sealed package. After opening, consume within 2–3 weeks to maintain crispness.
